_note: Public figures used by seed.py. A value is used ONLY when status is ANCHORED and it has a real source_name + url. Until then seed.py uses its own fallback value tagged ASSUMPTION. Fill from the Qwen research after checking each URL.

household_car_ownership.notes: Share of households with at least one private car, Amman.

smartphone_by_age.notes: Dict of age band -> share owning a smartphone / using the internet.

disability_by_age.notes: Dict of age band -> share with a mobility difficulty.
